Reason: Comparing Figure 1 and Figure 2 reveals that the extensive consolidation previously seen in the left lung has significantly cleared, while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right upper lung zone. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area accompanied by new infiltrates in another (migratory infiltrates) is a hallmark radiographic feature of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
